message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下可靠來源：

| 資料來源 | 連結 |
|----------|------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| 美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC） | https://www.cftc.gov/ |

這些網站通常會提供實時或延遲幾分鐘的黃金現貨價格、期貨合約價格以及相關市場分析。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current price. We don't have real-time data. We can respond with a disclaimer that we cannot fetch live data. But maybe we can approximate or say we can't provide real-time. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. So we should say we don't have real-time data. Possibly we can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc. Also we can mention typical price range. But we should not provide inaccurate info. So best answer: "I don't have real-time data; you can check X."
